description:
Returns the actual text of the authenticated person's saved resume: the extracted text of an upload
or the text of an existing saved version. Without an ID it reads the primary or only resume, or
identifies versions to choose from. A continued read uses the returned resume.id, revision, and nextOffset
as resume_id, revision and offset. The read requires permission from the current connection.
This tool reads content; resume_check explains how hiring software parsed a resume.
name: resume_get
title: Read my saved resume
